claim: pgmnemo 0.21.0 fixes a silent data-loss bug: pg_extension.extconfig was empty in all prior versions, causing pg_dump to omit user-data tables. The fix adds pg_extension_config_dump() calls for agent_lesson, mem_edge, memory_ingest_log, and their id sequences. No schema changes, no function changes, no query-plan changes. Recall quality and latency are byte-for-byte identical to 0.20.0.
criterion: No schema or function changes in 0.21.0. All existing pg_regress tests continue to pass unchanged. The new test test_v0210_dump_restore verifies pg_extension.extconfig is correctly populated. Δrecall@K = 0.0 by construction.

significance_test.method: No-change proof: 0.21.0 modifies only pg_extension.extconfig metadata; all functions, indexes, and table definitions are identical to 0.20.0.
significance_test.candidate: v0.21.0 — only change is pg_extension_config_dump() registrations
significance_test.result: NO REGRESSION — null hypothesis sustained by code inspection (no query-plan changes)

result.correctness_note: pg_extension_config_dump() is a catalog-metadata operation only. It registers table OIDs in pg_extension.extconfig; it does not modify table data, indexes, functions, or query plans. The fix has no runtime effect on pgmnemo queries.
result.carry_forward_basis: Identical to v0.9.7, v0.10.1, v0.13.0 correctness carry-forwards in benchmarks/METRICS_BY_VERSION.md — all established that no-schema-change releases do not require empirical re-run.

upgrade_parity.note: pgmnemo--0.21.0.sql = pgmnemo--0.20.0.sql || pg_extension_config_dump() block. The upgrade script pgmnemo--0.20.0--0.21.0.sql applies the same six pg_extension_config_dump() calls. Both paths produce identical pg_extension.extconfig state.
